EIB EPTATF-Eastern Partnership Technical AssistanceTrust Fund: EaP

description.narrative:
EIB: The overall objective for the European Union's priorities in the East is prosperity, stability and safety, which also forms EIB's mandate for the Eastern Partnership. The Eastern Partnership Technical Assistance Trust Fund is a multi-year standing fund. Its purpose is to enable the European Investment Bank to provide technical assistance to improve the quality and development impact of the Bank's Eastern Partnership operations through targeted technical support.
EPTATF: The EPTATF is expected to contribute to the following overall objectives: sustainable socio-economic development in Eastern Partnership Countries in line with the EIBs revised external lending mandate; and capacity development in Eastern Partnership Countries(institutional, regulatory, organisational and individual) for preparation and implementation of infrastructure investments including urban development and climate change mitigation and adaptation.
The delivery of TA aims to facilitate investment by supporting project preparation and implementation in the region. The priority sectors are:
- local private sector development, enhanced access to finance for SMEs
- development of social and economic infrastructure, and;
- climate change mitigation and adaptation.
EPTATF has implemented the Strategic Priorities for 2021-2027 to be in line with the EU agenda for EaP countries and are focused on reinforcing resilient, sustainable and integrated economies, environment and climate resilience and digital transformation.

Fonden för tekniskt bistånd till det östliga partnerskapet (EPTATF) inrättades 2010 för att finansiera tekniskt bistånd i länderna i det östliga partnerskapet och stödja EIB:s utlåning till dessa länder inom ramen för EU:s externa utlåningsmandat (ELM). Prioriterade områden är utveckling av den privata sektorn, utveckling av social och ekonomisk infrastruktur samt begränsning av och anpassning till klimatförändringar. Fonden ger också stöd till projektidentifiering, förberedande studier, miljöstudier, kapacitetsuppbyggnadsprogram, såsom utbildning i mottagarländerna och bidrag till institutionella program. Eftersom EIB:s resurser för tekniskt bistånd (TA) är begränsade och endast står för 2 % av det tekniska bistånd som tillhandahålls i länderna i det östliga partnerskapet, inrättades EPTATF som en specialiserad, mångsidig och sektorsövergripande trustfond som förvaltas av EIB under överinseende av bidragsgivarkommittén. Dessutom kompletterar EPTATF mekanismer som kombinerar EIB-lån med andra finansieringskällor, däribland EU:s investeringsfacilitet för grannländerna (NIF) och partnerskapet för energieffektivitet och miljö i Östeuropa (E5P). Sedan EPTATF inrättades 2010 har medel från denna förvaltningsfond tilldelats olika sektorer för att stödja förberedelserna och genomförandet av EIB:s utlåning.

The Eastern Partnership Technical Assistance Trust Fund (EPTATF) was established in 2010 to finance grant technical assistance operations in Eastern Partnership countries to support EIB lending to the EaP countries under the EU External Lending Mandate (ELM). Priority areas include private sector development, social and economic infrastructure development and climate change mitigation and adaptation. The trust fund also provides support for project identification, preparation of feasibility studies, environmental studies, capacity-building programmes, such as training in beneficiary countries and grants for institutional programmes. Since EIB’s resources for technical assistance (TA) are limited and only account for 2% of TA provided in the EaP countries, EPTATF was set up as an EIB-dedicated multipurpose and multi-sector trust fund that is managed by the EIB under the oversight of the Contributors Committee. Additionally EPTATF complements mechanisms which blend EIB loans with other funding sources, including the EU Neighbourhood Investment Facility (NIF) and the Eastern Europe Efficiency and Environment Partnership (E5P). Since the creation of EPTATF in 2010 resources from this Trust Fund have been allocated to different sectors to support the preparation and implementation of EIB lending.

description.narrative:
Sida is still the largest contributor over the lifetime of the fund. No new contributions were approved during 2024, but two new projects were approved in March 2025: TA for water resilience in Syunik, Armenia and TA for project preparation for the Baku Metro.
During 2024 only 1.7 MEUR was disbursed, however during the life of the fund as much as 86% has been disbursed, which is very good for a fund of this kind.
During Januari 2025 a special project for Gender and Social Inclusion was approved. This is funding that can be used for including these aspects in other projects.
EPTATF presents which countries that are among the procured companies for the approved projects. Most companies come from Germany, France and Denmark, while none come from Sweden.
During 2024 only one project was completed: the Water Infrastructure Modernization Project in Georgia. The TA connected to the project was finalized in 2019, while the project itself was finalized during 2024.
The reporting from EPTATF is in general very comprehensive and includes an intervention logic framework that can be reviewed in more detail when needed.
